name: sil-hr
description: SIL HR: human resources and payroll, the hospital's system of record for people and structure

scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @sil/hr-api build && pnpm --filter @sil/hr-web build
scripts.test: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @sil/hr-api test && pnpm --filter @sil/hr-web test
scripts.openapi:update: pnpm build:shared && UPDATE_OPENAPI=1 pnpm --filter @sil/hr-api exec jest test/openapi.spec.ts && pnpm --filter @sil/hr-shared generate:client
